def transform(grid):
    hh=len(grid);ww=len(grid[0])
    sep=None; fr=fc=[]
    for c in range(10):
        fr=[i for i in range(hh) if all(grid[i][j]==c for j in range(ww))]
        fc=[j for j in range(ww) if all(grid[i][j]==c for i in range(hh))]
        if fr or fc: sep=c;break
    sr=[-1]+fr+[hh]; sc=[-1]+fc+[ww]
    rgs=[(sr[a]+1,sr[a+1]) for a in range(len(sr)-1)]
    cgs=[(sc[b]+1,sc[b+1]) for b in range(len(sc)-1)]
    from collections import Counter
    vals=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r if x!=sep)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
